sgen1.name: sgen1
sgen1.authors_source: author's page (eeecs.qub.ac.uk/~I.Spence/sgen) and the header of sgen1.c
sgen1.license_note: no licence in the source nor on the page: the recipe is published, the image is not, until the author agrees
sgen1.seed: -s, default 1; the generator uses its own linear congruential generator
sgen1.notes: main() always returns 1, even on success; the verifier ignores the exit status and checks the output instead

cnfgen.name: CNFgen
cnfgen.usage: cnfgen FAMILY PARAMETERS...; cnfgen --help lists the families
cnfgen.seed: random families take a seed option; Python's random module does not promise identical draws across Python versions
cnfgen.license_note: GPL-3.0: the image is publishable provided its sources travel with it, which the pinned PyPI release and the recorded version give

lockchart.name: lockchart-to-cnf
lockchart.authors_source: repository nrilu/lockchart-to-cnf and the SAT Competition 2025 benchmark description
lockchart.seed: none; with -r the lock-chart is randomised from the clock and cannot be reproduced
lockchart.notes: the script draws the lock-chart after writing the formula, which needs LaTeX and fails in the image; the formula is already complete at that point

oddball.name: Oddball
oddball.authors_source: repository acmihal/oddball and the SAT Competition 2025 benchmark description
oddball.license_note: the repository declares no licence: the recipe is published, the image is not, until the author agrees
oddball.seed: none; the formula is built through z3 and is deterministic

commattach.name: Community Attachment
commattach.authors_source: header printed by the generator and the IJCAI 2015 paper
competitions: SAT Competition 2016 and later, as the random-modularity family
commattach.license_note: the repository declares no licence: the recipe is published, the image is not, until the authors agree
commattach.usage: commAttach -n VARIABLES -m CLAUSES -k CLAUSE_LENGTH -c COMMUNITIES -Q MODULARITY -s SEED
commattach.seed: -s, mandatory for reproducibility; the repository also builds a plain random k-CNF generator

mdp.name: mdp-benchmark
mdp.authors_source: repository rebryant/mdp-benchmark and the SAT Competition 2022 benchmark description
mdp.seed: -s; the repository ships src/generate.sh, the script that produced the submitted instances

roundrobin.name: Round-robin tournament scheduling
roundrobin.authors_source: repository Aeacu2/RR-Benchmarks and the SAT Competition 2025 benchmark description
roundrobin.usage: rr-gen rr TEAMS ROUNDS | rr-gen mv TEAMS ROUNDS VENUES
roundrobin.notes: the submitted scripts keep their instance list at the top of the file; the entry point substitutes the single instance asked for and runs the encoder verbatim

genxormiter.name: genxormiter
genxormiter.seed: the second positional argument; without it the generator seeds itself from the clock and the instance cannot be reproduced
genxormiter.notes: the miter between two parity circuits over shared inputs: solvable by XOR reasoning, trivially with -s, and still solvable with -r; -l disables the randomisation of the variable order. Beware of the seed: in this version parse_seed assigns instead of accumulating, so only the last digit of a multi-digit seed is used, and 2, 42, 12 and 102 all give the same instance. Use single-digit seeds until it is fixed upstream.
